<header class="top"><div><div class="brand">☾ Let's Learn Arabic</div><div class="subbrand">The basics · Practice at your pace</div></div><button id="home" class="btn home hidden" type="button">⌂ Main menu</button></header>
<section id="menu" class="section"><div class="eyebrow">Choose a deck</div><h1>What shall we learn today?</h1><p>Select a topic, then choose exactly which cards to practice. Start with the first five letters or select any combination.</p><div id="decks" class="decks"><button type="button" class="deck" data-deck="letters"><span class="glyph">ا</span><strong>Arabic Letters</strong><small>28 cards</small></button><button type="button" class="deck" data-deck="forms"><span class="glyph">بـ</span><strong>Letter Forms</strong><small>28 cards</small></button><button type="button" class="deck" data-deck="numbers"><span class="glyph">١٢٣</span><strong>Numbers</strong><small>38 cards</small></button><button type="button" class="deck" data-deck="colors"><span class="glyph">🎨</span><strong>Colors</strong><small>12 cards</small></button><button type="button" class="deck" data-deck="foods"><span class="glyph">🍓</span><strong>Fruits & Vegetables</strong><small>20 cards</small></button><button type="button" class="deck" data-deck="animals"><span class="glyph">🐪</span><strong>Animals</strong><small>16 cards</small></button></div><p id="appStatus" class="caption" role="status">If tapping a deck does nothing, the JavaScript file may be incomplete. Re-upload this entire index.html file to GitHub.</p><div class="note">✓ Mark the ones you know · × Mark the ones to practice again. Use Previous and Next to browse, then review missed cards.</div></section>
<section id="picker" class="section hidden"><div class="eyebrow">Choose cards</div><h1 id="pickTitle">Select cards</h1><p>Tap the cards you want included in this lesson.</p><div class="selection-tools"><button id="all" class="btn">Select all</button><button id="first5" class="btn">First 5</button><button id="none" class="btn">Clear</button></div><div id="choices" class="choices"></div><div class="start-row"><strong id="selectedCount">0 selected</strong><button id="begin" class="btn primary" disabled>Practice selected cards</button></div></section>
<section id="study" class="section hidden"><div id="studyName" class="eyebrow"></div><div class="study-meta"><span id="round">Round 1</span><span id="position"></span></div><div class="progress"><span id="progressFill" style="width:0"></span></div>
<button id="card" class="card" type="button"><img id="image" class="hidden" alt=""><span id="symbol" class="arabic" dir="rtl" lang="ar"></span><span id="answer" class="answer hidden"></span><span id="hint" class="hint">Tap to reveal the answer</span></button>
<div class="voice-controls"><label for="voice">Arabic pronunciation voice (your iPhone)</label><select id="voice"><option value="auto">Automatic Arabic voice</option></select><div class="caption" id="voiceNote">Formal Arabic vocabulary and letter names. iPhone voices do not guarantee Qur'anic tajwīd.</div></div>
<div class="buttons"><button id="listen" class="btn wide" type="button">🔊 Hear Arabic</button><button id="incorrect" class="btn bad" type="button">✕ Practice again</button><button id="correct" class="btn good" type="button">✓ I knew it</button><button id="previous" class="btn" type="button">← Previous</button><button id="next" class="btn primary" type="button">Next →</button><button id="change" class="btn wide secondary" type="button">Change card selection</button></div>
<div class="caption" id="status" aria-live="polite"></div></section>
<section id="end" class="section hidden"><div class="finished"><div class="star">🌟</div><h2 id="endTitle">Nice work!</h2><p id="endText"></p><div class="buttons"><button id="review" class="btn primary wide">Review missed cards</button><button id="restart" class="btn">Practice these again</button><button id="reselect" class="btn">Change cards</button><button id="endHome" class="btn wide">Main menu</button></div></div></section>
<footer class="footer">✦ Learn · Listen · Practice · Repeat ✦</footer></main>

const screens=['menu','picker','study','end'];
let deck=null,selectedIndices=[],queue=[],marks=new Map(),cursor=0,round=1,flipped=false,voiceList=[];
function view(name){screens.forEach(id=>$(id).classList.toggle('hidden',id!==name));$('home').classList.toggle('hidden',name==='menu');window.scrollTo(0,0)}
function stopAudio(){if('speechSynthesis' in window)window.speechSynthesis.cancel()}
function home(){stopAudio();deck=null;view('menu')}
$('home').onclick=home;$('endHome').onclick=home;
function escape(s){return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]))}
for(const d of DECKS){const b=document.querySelector('[data-deck="'+d.id+'"]');if(b)b.onclick=()=>choose(d)}
$('appStatus').textContent='Ready — choose a deck to begin.';
function choose(d){deck=d;stopAudio();let saved=null;try{saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('arabicFlashcardsSelection:'+d.id)||'null')}catch{};selectedIndices=Array.isArray(saved)?saved.filter(x=>Number.isInteger(x)&&x>=0&&x<d.cards.length):d.cards.map((_,i)=>i);renderSelection();view('picker')}
function renderSelection(){
 $('pickTitle').textContent='Choose '+deck.name;const container=$('choices');container.replaceChildren();
 deck.cards.forEach((card,i)=>{const lab=document.createElement('label');lab.className='choice';const check=document.createElement('input');check.type='checkbox';check.checked=selectedIndices.includes(i);check.setAttribute('aria-label','Include '+(card.label||card.back));check.onchange=()=>{selectedIndices=deck.cards.map((_,j)=>j).filter(j=>container.children[j].querySelector('input').checked);updateSelection()};lab.append(check);
 if(card.picture){const img=document.createElement('img');img.src=card.picture;img.alt=card.label||'';lab.append(img)}else{const glyph=document.createElement('span');glyph.className='symbol';glyph.textContent=card.front;lab.append(glyph)}
 const t=document.createElement('small');t.textContent=card.label||card.back;lab.append(t);container.append(lab)});updateSelection()}
function updateSelection(){const n=selectedIndices.length;$('selectedCount').textContent=n+' card'+(n===1?'':'s')+' selected';$('begin').disabled=n===0;try{localStorage.setItem('arabicFlashcardsSelection:'+deck.id,JSON.stringify(selectedIndices))}catch{}}
function pickIndices(indices){selectedIndices=indices;renderSelection()}
$('all').onclick=()=>pickIndices(deck.cards.map((_,i)=>i));$('first5').onclick=()=>pickIndices(deck.cards.slice(0,5).map((_,i)=>i));$('none').onclick=()=>pickIndices([]);
function begin(indices=selectedIndices,isReview=false){if(!indices.length)return;stopAudio();if(!isReview){selectedIndices=[...indices];round=1}else round++;queue=[...indices];marks=new Map();cursor=0;showCard();view('study')}
$('begin').onclick=()=>begin();
function current(){return deck.cards[queue[cursor]]}
function showCard(){stopAudio();flipped=false;const item=current();if(!item){finish();return}const picture=$('image');picture.classList.toggle('hidden',!item.picture);picture.src=item.picture||'';picture.alt=item.picture?item.label||'Vocabulary picture':'';$('symbol').textContent=item.front;$('symbol').className='arabic'+(deck.id==='forms'?' forms':(['foods','animals','colors'].includes(deck.id)?' words':''));$('answer').textContent=item.back;$('answer').classList.add('hidden');$('hint').textContent='Tap to reveal the answer';$('studyName').textContent=deck.name;$('round').textContent=round===1?'First round':'Review round '+round;$('position').textContent='Card '+(cursor+1)+' of '+queue.length;$('progressFill').style.width=(marks.size/queue.length*100)+'%';$('previous').disabled=cursor===0;$('next').textContent=cursor===queue.length-1?'Finish round →':'Next →';const g=marks.get(queue[cursor]);$('correct').textContent=g===true?'✓ Correct (selected)':'✓ I knew it';$('incorrect').textContent=g===false?'✕ Review (selected)':'✕ Practice again';$('status').textContent=g===undefined?'You can browse without grading, or mark ✓ or ×.':g?'Marked correct. You can change your answer.':'Marked for review. You can change your answer.'}
function flip(){if(flipped)return;flipped=true;$('answer').classList.remove('hidden');$('hint').textContent='Mark ✓ or ×, or move to another card'}
$('card').onclick=flip;
function mark(value){marks.set(queue[cursor],value);const nextIndex=cursor+1;if(nextIndex<queue.length){cursor=nextIndex;showCard()}else finish()}
$('correct').onclick=()=>mark(true);$('incorrect').onclick=()=>mark(false);
$('previous').onclick=()=>{if(cursor>0){cursor--;showCard()}};
$('next').onclick=()=>{if(cursor<queue.length-1){cursor++;showCard()}else finish()};
$('change').onclick=()=>{stopAudio();renderSelection();view('picker')};
function finish(){stopAudio();const wrong=queue.filter(i=>marks.get(i)!==true),right=queue.filter(i=>marks.get(i)===true);$('endTitle').textContent=wrong.length?'Great effort! Keep practicing.':'Wonderful! All correct!';$('endText').textContent=right.length+' correct · '+wrong.length+' to review. Skipped cards are included in review.';$('review').classList.toggle('hidden',wrong.length===0);$('review').onclick=()=>begin(wrong,true);view('end')}
$('restart').onclick=()=>begin(selectedIndices,false);$('reselect').onclick=()=>{renderSelection();view('picker')};
function refreshVoices(){if(!('speechSynthesis' in window))return;const voices=speechSynthesis.getVoices().filter(v=>v.lang.toLowerCase().startsWith('ar'));const old=$('voice').value;voiceList=voices;$('voice').replaceChildren();const auto=new Option('Automatic Arabic voice','auto');$('voice').add(auto);voices.forEach((v,i)=>$('voice').add(new Option(v.name+' ('+v.lang+')',String(i))));$('voice').value=[...$('voice').options].some(x=>x.value===old)?old:'auto';if(!voices.length)$('voiceNote').textContent='No Arabic voice is installed or exposed by this browser. You may need to install an Arabic speech voice in iPhone settings.';else $('voiceNote').textContent='Choose any installed Arabic voice. This is device speech, not a verified Qur’anic recitation or tajwīd recording.'}
refreshVoices();if('speechSynthesis' in window)speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged=refreshVoices;
$('listen').onclick=()=>{const item=current();if(!item)return;if(!('speechSynthesis' in window)){alert('Speech is not supported in this browser.');return}stopAudio();const u=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(item.say||item.front);let voice=null;if($('voice').value!=='auto')voice=voiceList[Number($('voice').value)];if(!voice)voice=voiceList.find(v=>v.lang.toLowerCase()==='ar-001')||voiceList[0];if(voice){u.voice=voice;u.lang=voice.lang}else u.lang='ar';u.rate=.78;u.pitch=1;u.onerror=()=>{$('voiceNote').textContent='That Arabic voice could not play this word. Try another voice from the list.'};speechSynthesis.speak(u)};
</script></body></html>
